# metamcp_api_key (Data Source)

Looks up an existing MetaMCP API key by name or UUID.

The key value is exposed and marked sensitive.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing API key by name, or by UUID.
data "metamcp_api_key" "ci" {
  name = "ci-pipeline"
}

output "ci_key_active" {
  value = data.metamcp_api_key.ci.is_active
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) API key name. Exactly one of `uuid` or `name` must be set.
- `uuid` (String) API key UUID. Exactly one of `uuid` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `key` (String, Sensitive)
